# Squish Shelf

> Press, stretch and poke squishy toys. Open blind boxes and run your own little squish shop. Free to play, no ads, 12 languages. Android (Google Play), itch.io and web browser.

Squish Shelf is a relaxing squishy-toy game. Players press and hold to squeeze realistic toys (mochi, jelly, bubble wrap, caramel, slime, pop-its, stress balls); each material has its own feel, sound and vibration, and every toy eventually breaks. Players collect themed blind-box series (12 regular toys plus 1 hidden toy each), and run a toy shop that attracts visitors and tips.

## Facts
- Price: free to play, optional in-app purchases (gems; Squish Club monthly at $2.99; Winter Pass $9.99; starter pack $0.99). No ads.
- Free play: daily taster toy, daily free restock, daily tasks that give a blind-box ticket (about one box a day without paying).
- Blind box odds: regular toys equally likely; hidden toy 1 in 144, guaranteed within 120 boxes of a series.
- Platforms: Android via Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.descu.squishshelf), itch.io (https://pplayergame.itch.io/squish-shelf), browser (https://squish.vitacazap.com/play/).
- Languages: English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Español, Português, Français, Deutsch, Bahasa Indonesia, ไทย, Tiếng Việt.
- Publisher: DESCU AI. Privacy policy: https://squish.vitacazap.com/privacy/
